Omar Abdullah Questions Centre on J&K Statehood Delay

Omar Abdullah, identified as Chief Minister, has challenged the Centre to clarify the delay in restoring statehood to Jammu and Kashmir. He stated that the people should not be humiliated and that previous assurances of statehood at an "appropriate time" have become meaningless.
